_meta.description: Declared row-state registry for aws_li_to_gcp_li. Single source of truth for DDL, value domains, writer permissions, and note rendering.

aws_li_key.description: MD5 hash identifying the unique AWS line item dedup tuple.

gcp_service.description: GCP target service name (e.g. Compute Engine, Cloud Storage).

gcp_sku_id.description: Canonical GCP SKU ID or synthetic identifier.

gcp_sku_name.description: GCP SKU description / display name from catalog.

gcp_sku_unit.description: GCP billing unit (e.g. GiBy.mo, h, requests).

component.description: Component breakdown role: core, ram, storage, license, etc.

needs_reprice.note_template: Carried at AWS cost pending re-pricing.

strategy.description: How this row's GCP cost is produced.

unit_multiplier.description: Numeric quantity multiplier to align AWS usage unit with GCP SKU unit.

gcp_region.description: Target GCP region code (e.g. us-central1, europe-west1).

word_overlap.note_template: SKU matched by word overlap — verify before quoting.

no_rate.note_template: No GCP rate reachable for this SKU; carried at AWS cost.

no_catalog.note_template: GCP catalog unavailable at run time; carried at AWS cost.

rate_source.description: How the GCP rate for this row was obtained.

global.note_template: Global charge; priced at the {rate_region_used} rate.

dominant.note_template: No rate in {gcp_region}; priced at the {rate_region_used} rate.

cheapest_available.note_template: No rate in {gcp_region}; priced at the cheapest available region ({rate_region_used}).

rate_region_basis.description: Which region's rate was actually applied.

rate_region_used.description: The specific region whose rate table provided pricing when rate_region_basis is not exact.

premium_not_modeled.note_template: AWS price includes an OS/engine licence premium that is not modeled on the GCP side.

service_model_change.note_template: Service model differs between clouds — review the architecture, not just the price.

log_ingestion_model.note_template: Log ingestion is priced on a different basis on GCP.

verify_with_customer.note_template: Verify this assumption with the customer.

region_unavailable.note_template: Requested region unavailable for this resource.

cost_may_differ.note_template: Real cost may differ materially from this estimate.

capacity_adjusted.note_template: GCP vCPU/RAM was scaled up to match the AWS instance footprint.

review_flags.description: Caveats and warnings that do not change the number but change how it should be read.

mapping_confidence.description: DEPRECATED: Uncalibrated confidence score, retained for database backward-compatibility.

is_workload.description: True if row represents customer workload spend, False for non-workload (tax, credits, support).

break_down.description: True if single AWS line item is broken into multiple GCP component rows.

gcp_machine_type.description: Target GCE machine type or Cloud SQL instance tier.

is_assumption.description: True if mapping relies on heuristic assumption.

forced_assumption_key.description: When an assumption forces passthrough (e.g. via passthrough_enforcer.py), records the governing assumption key. NULL when not forced via assumption.

passthrough_reason.description: Standardized reason why row is carried at AWS cost or needs reprice.

decided_by.description: Script or source file that made the final strategy/passthrough decision.

mapper_note.description: The mapper's or LLM's own explanation. Rendered into the note; never matched against.

pipeline_note.description: Free-text rationale contributed by deterministic pipeline passes that has no enum equivalent (e.g. a service_map policy reason, a directive disclosure, a remap explanation). Multiple parts are joined with ' · '. Rendered into the note; never matched against to make a mapping decision.

projection_note.description: Generated from state by scripts/render_notes.py. Output only.

applied_directives.description: JSON array of directive ids that touched this row (Directive Layer provenance). Written by scripts/apply_directives.py; never matched against.
